motivation: State component controls localize82.73percent of lawful-neighbor first-impact disagreement to struck-pin R/v; restoring only orientation33.75percent or velocity19.27percent is weaker. Axial state, other pins, ball and numerical warmstart do not explain the large difference. Test whether the original10Hz observations resolve the instantaneous visible motion involved.
sources: all20original validation collision centers,first eligible event pin(s); no new selection,no tests
trace: replay original frozen actions with mj_step(nstep10) expanded into10 calls(nstep1), log native qpos each2ms over the last1s. Every50Hz qpos boundary and native future continuation must remain bitwise equal to original raw trajectory.
inputs: original21semantic points only for velocity estimation; current original quaternion and all other state are kept to isolate the estimation of struck-pin linear/transverse angular velocity. Retain native axial spin. This is a simulator-oracle sensitivity control, not a learned point-only prediction model.

estimators.axial: retain current native projection along long axis
estimators.boundary: all samples at or before query; future points never used to estimate velocity

arms: 12 rate/estimator/precision combinations plus unmodified original_native and original_forward controls; change only target pin qvel; same solver,timestep,model,actions; run100ms; do not train or correct any neural output
metrics: raw100ms displacement error relative original endpoints,then target pins,then20episode macro; also report instantaneous endpoint velocity estimation errors,per-episode values and full raw traces

decision.sampling_sensitivity: for float32 first-order estimates,10Hz oracle error>5mm and500Hz error<1mm,>=80percent reduction,paired95CI(500Hzminus10Hz)upper<0. This demonstrates a sampling-interval effect for this estimator and mechanism, NOT impossibility of recovering state from the full10Hzhistory.
decision.alternative: if high-rate estimates do not approach the native continuation, check frame/velocity convention and discrete integration before interpreting. No model architecture claim from this alone.

limits: Native orientation,axial spin,other objects and physics are privileged controls, so this is not an end-to-end21point-only model.
Failure of backward differences at10Hz does not prove that every estimator or entire history lacks information.
All20centers were already used in diagnosis, not fresh independent test trials.
